0022600192.text: The Washington Wizards (4-5, 2nd in the Southeast and 8th in the East, on a two-game losing streak) visit the Oklahoma City Thunder (7-2, 1st in the Northwest, winners of three straight and 4-0 at home), with both teams having played nine games so far. Washington is missing Anthony Davis (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms) and Thomas Sorber (knee). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Wizards lost both games to Oklahoma City in 2025-26, including a 132-111 defeat in Washington on March 21, 2026.
